## Description

Hangfire server (Worker.Jobs) on Azure SQL in its own schema/user — no Redis or Service Bus in P1. Email provider: SendGrid (founder decision 20 Oct 2026, free tier) behind the Notifications adapter; Azure Communication Services remains an alternative. Events: booking confirmation, reschedule, cancellation, 24 h and 2 h reminders, leave rebooking. Templates per tenant/language without clinical details. NOTIFICATION and NOTIFICATION_ATTEMPT record provider id, delivery state and retries with backoff; reminders are cancelled when the appointment changes.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Booking triggers a confirmation within 1 minute; reminders are sent at 24 h and 2 h before (facility time), respecting quiet hours and channel consent.
- [ ] **AC2.** Rescheduling or cancelling cancels pending reminders and sends the right message once (idempotency test).
- [ ] **AC3.** Delivery status (queued, sent, delivered, failed, bounced) is stored and visible to reception for each appointment.
- [ ] **AC4.** Failed sends are retried with backoff up to the configured limit and then shown as failed on the board/notification centre.
- [ ] **AC5.** Hangfire dashboard is only reachable by Medvya operations through authenticated admin route; no Redis or Service Bus resources exist in P1 infrastructure.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
